propositions: Pass-1 instructions must discover only grounded candidates without assessing validity, impact, severity, confidence, drop/block policy, or remediation
Pass-2 instructions must answer only atomic validity and impact questions without discovering new findings, deciding outcomes, or prescribing fixes
Pass-3 must apply deterministic thresholds without LLM judgment or evidence gathering; Pass-4 must offer non-prescriptive guidance without re-verifying or altering decisions

The project.review-phase-boundaries criterion emits evidence-grounded findings with empty suggested_fix, zero severity/confidence, and fires on RP-F1..RP-F6 (assessment/policy/remediation leaks, Pass-2 ownership, discretionary Pass-3, coaching boundary violations) while abstaining on RP-N1..RP-N6 (valid scope/evidence/question refinement, deterministic routing, coaching, documentation)
Three-run calibration must achieve recall=1.0, false_accept=0.0, agreement=1.0, stability_min≥2/3, and kappa≥0.70 across 12-case corpus with model, timestamp, and all 36 executions recorded

Project assets are confined to .rebar/ prompt/routing/eval files, criterion-specific tests, docs subsection, and .gitignore exceptions; routing uses block_threshold=0.90 with blocking_enabled=false and single-turn 1-TURN execution
